data.intent: Add a gamified token economy to Carter's Arcade: earn/spend tokens via gameplay, achievements, daily leaderboards, and riddles/tasks; new Next.js backend + admin dashboard at dev.cartercripe.com/arcade; Discord bot integration via a published API contract (bot built separately by Carter).
Scaffold arcade-backend/ Next.js project: Drizzle schema, Neon Postgres, Auth.js (Google), ledger write helper, games seed

data.summary: Scaffolded arcade-backend/ Next.js App Router project
Added arcade-backend/vercel.json scoped for Root Directory deploy (ADR-1)
Wrote lib/db/schema.ts covering all tech-design Data Models tables incl. content_items/content_completions
Implemented lib/ledger.ts as the sole transactions-writer (ADR-2), incl. adminAdjustBalance()
Wrote ledger.test.ts (balance reconstruction); passes except DB connectivity, pending Neon provisioning
Configured Auth.js Google provider (code complete, live verification pending real OAuth creds)
Stubbed Discord provider in Auth.js for later account-linking
Wrote scripts/seed.ts for the games table roster/costs
Reflected confirmed npm run dev/port + resolved NEEDS MANUAL REVIEW markers in approach.md

All 16 tasks done. Neon provisioned + migration applied + games seeded; ledger tests green against live DB; Google OAuth redirect verified end-to-end. Pooling spike PASSED (175 concurrent queries, <=7 of 112 connections).
data.canon_entry: arcade-backend: Next.js 16 App Router service, Drizzle + neon-http over Neon Postgres (pooler endpoint), Auth.js v5 (Google primary, Discord stubbed). Ledger-first: lib/ledger.ts is sole writer of transactions; balance = SUM(amount).
data.notes_for_evaluator: NEW CONSTRAINT for feat/economy-engine id:22 — db.transaction() throws on neon-http; must use single-statement data-modifying CTE (pattern verified live) or db.batch(). Also fixed: missing .env.example, missing AUTH_SECRET, .gitignore swallowing the env template.

data.intent: Economy engine library layer: lib/achievements.ts (threshold + interval-gap evaluation, ADR-3/ADR-5 idempotency), lib/leaderboard.ts (midnight bucketing, +5 participation, 2+-submitter top-score gating, games.default_top_score_award fallback), lib/spend.ts (deduct-before-play, InsufficientBalanceError), daily login bonus, lib/content.ts (riddle/trivia once-per-day, task unlimited). Pure library, no HTTP routes. Adds games.default_top_score_award column + migration (id:33).

data.summary: Economy library layer complete: achievements (threshold + interval-gap), leaderboard (bucketing, +5 participation, 2+-submitter gating, bounty/default award), spend, daily login bonus, content. 45 tests green against live Postgres; 100% stmt/line/function coverage on the five lib modules.
data.canon_entry: arcade-backend/lib: ledger.ts is the sole transactions writer (ADR-2); atomic multi-write paths use single-statement data-modifying CTEs because neon-http has no db.transaction(). Idempotency is constraint-based throughout: achievement_awards unique key, content_completions partial unique index, daily_top_score_settlements PK. Interval-gap awards are the exception (repeatable by design) and use a watermark compare-and-set.
data.notes_for_evaluator: Two schema additions (ids 38-39) beyond the original plan, both fixing races in read-then-write guards; id:39 was found by a failing test. One approach.md acceptance criterion diverges as literally written: interval-gap awards write no achievement_awards row, flagged inline for Builder confirmation. Partitions 3 and 4 can now run in parallel per approach.md.

data.intent: HTTP route layer + published Discord bot contract: bot service-API-key middleware (constant-time), 8 routes (balance, spend, scores/submit, bounty/pending, bounty/set, users/by-discord-id, content, content/complete), plus Builder-decided POST /api/cron/settle-daily + Vercel cron entry as the trigger for the one-shot daily top-score settle. zod schemas on every route, CORS allow-list, integration tests, docs/discord-bot-api.md. Consumes the frozen lib/ layer read-only.
